widgets_values: A 21:9 ultra-wide gothic dark fantasy scene showing a plague-era astrologer standing atop a colossal bell tower overlooking a vast diseased city under a blood-red moon. The architecture is dense with cathedral spires, bridges, plague fires, gigantic bells, and blackened rooftops stretching into fog. Above the city, enormous celestial instruments and iron rings loom in the stormy sky. The astrologer wears layered dark robes, a beaked ceremonial mask, and carries brass astrolabes and lantern light. The world should feel cursed, grand, and deeply mournful, with dramatic red moonlight, greenish fog, candlelit windows, and baroque detail. Epic, painterly, haunting, richly textured, and emotionally intense.

A 21:9 ultra-wide gothic dark fantasy battle scene showing Batman, Darth Vader, Wolverine, and Spawn fighting side by side inside a colossal ruined cathedral overrun by demonic armies. Moonlight cuts through shattered stained glass while plague-red fire burns across broken pews and fallen angel statues. Batman moves through shadows with a torn cape and blood-streaked armor, Darth Vader advances through smoke with a crimson lightsaber, Wolverine tears through monstrous soldiers in a frenzy of claws and sparks, and Spawn erupts with chains and hellfire near the altar. The world should feel brutal, tragic, and operatic, with broken armor, blood on stone floors, incense smoke, candlelit ruins, shattered relics, and immense baroque detail. Ultra-cinematic, painterly, violent, emotionally intense, and visually overwhelming.
A 21:9 ultra-wide cyberpunk war scene featuring Spider-Man, Ghost Rider, Harley Quinn, and Deadpool trapped in a savage rooftop battle above a neon megacity during a thunderstorm. The skyline is packed with holograms, flying police vehicles, collapsing billboards, and burning high-rises, while rain mixes with blood across glass surfaces and reflective steel. Spider-Man swings through tracer fire with his suit torn and bruised, Ghost Rider rides a flaming bike through armed cyborgs and blazing wreckage, Harley Quinn strikes with manic energy amid neon graffiti and shattered drones, and Deadpool stands laughing in a chaotic melee with katanas drawn. The atmosphere should feel chaotic, stylish, and brutally kinetic, with crimson splashes, electric blue and magenta reflections, smoke plumes, shattered glass, and explosive cinematic energy.
A 21:9 ultra-wide mythic battlefield scene showing Wonder Woman, Kratos, Thor, and Aquaman waging a blood-soaked war against titans on the shores of a shattered divine kingdom. Giant statues collapse into the surf, storm clouds swirl above golden temples, and lightning tears open the sky while waves crash over broken shields and fallen warriors. Wonder Woman charges with shield and sword, Kratos cleaves through giant enemies with ash-covered fury, Thor summons thunder over splintered siege engines, and Aquaman rises from the black surf with monstrous sea beasts behind him. The world should feel immense, sacred, and merciless, with torn banners, shattered columns, blood-streaked marble, burning braziers, and epic high-contrast lighting. Grand, violent, mythological, and emotionally devastating.
A 21:9 ultra-wide medieval siege scene featuring Link, Geralt of Rivia, Aragorn, and Jon Snow fighting desperately atop a fortress wall during the fall of a cursed city. Below them, ladders, siege towers, and monstrous armies pour through fire and smoke while trebuchets rain burning stones into the streets. Link stands with sword and shield glowing amid blood and ash, Geralt cuts down armored beasts with silver blade in hand, Aragorn battles at the breached gate among ruined banners, and Jon Snow fights through snow, blood, and ruin beneath a blackened standard. The setting should feel grim, noble, and hopelessly heroic, with torchlight, broken battlements, shattered monster armor, snow mixing with blood, and immense dark-fantasy scale. Hyper-detailed, cinematic, brutal, and mournful.
A 21:9 ultra-wide science-fiction battlefield scene showing Master Chief, Doom Slayer, Samus Aran, and Predator fighting across a burning alien warzone filled with dead demons, shattered tanks, and collapsing orbital machinery. The horizon glows with nuclear fire and distant ring structures while dropships crash into trenches full of smoke, sparks, and blood-streaked wreckage. Master Chief moves through plasma fire with battle-worn armor, Doom Slayer stands amid gore-stained ruins and shell casings, Samus unleashes bright energy blasts into swarming creatures, and Predator stalks through smoke before striking with glowing blades. The world should feel ferocious, industrial, and apocalyptic, with molten metal, torn banners, sparks, toxic haze, glowing weapons, and impossible scale. Extremely violent, high-impact, cinematic, and relentless.
A 21:9 ultra-wide anime super-battle scene showing Goku, Naruto, Ichigo, and Gojo Satoru locked in a cataclysmic fight against an overwhelming demonic coalition above the ruins of a floating city. The sky is ripped apart by energy beams, torn clouds, shattered towers, and blazing shockwaves while blood and debris rain across the broken platforms below. Goku hovers amid radiant power and bruised skin, Naruto leads a furious charge with torn cloak and fox-energy tails, Ichigo carves through gigantic monstrosities with black blood spraying through the air, and Gojo stands calm inside a collapsing barrier while bodies and concrete fragments hang suspended around him. A 21:9 ultra-wide pirate war scene featuring Luffy, Jack Sparrow, Roronoa Zoro, and Davy Jones locked in a savage ship-to-ship battle during a black-ocean storm. Enormous waves crash into splintered galleons, cannon fire lights the rain, and broken masts fall into blood-stained water while tentacled sea monsters rise around the fleet. Luffy launches himself across the gap between ships with wild determination, Jack Sparrow fights chaotically through smoke and sword clashes, Zoro cuts through enemies in a spinning storm of blades and blood, and Davy Jones emerges from the wreckage like a sea demon commanding cursed sailors. The scene should feel violent, adventurous, and mythic, with torn sails, flaming decks, broken lanterns, ocean spray, blood across wet wood, and a cinematic sense of scale. Grand, feral, and unforgettable.
A 21:9 ultra-wide horror-fantasy battle scene showing Alucard, Blade, Van Helsing, and Trevor Belmont storming a vampiric fortress during a blood-red midnight siege. Gargoyle towers, giant chandeliers, crimson moonlight, and black iron staircases loom over a hall filled with shattered monsters, torn capes, and rivers of dark blood. Alucard stands in regal fury with blade and crimson coat, Blade slices through armored vampires beneath a spray of blood, Van Helsing fires into swarming beasts beside burning holy devices, and Trevor whips through skeletal horrors in a storm of shattered bone. The world should feel cursed, aristocratic, and mercilessly violent, with gothic luxury destroyed by battle, candles flickering in red haze, stained stone, broken mirrors, and dramatic shadow-heavy composition. Haunting, savage, painterly, and richly textured.
A 21:9 ultra-wide survival-horror action scene showing Leon Kennedy, Jill Valentine, Claire Redfield, and Pyramid Head clashing inside a grotesque hospital-city swallowed by fog, flesh-like walls, and rusted machinery. Corridors open into colossal operating theaters, broken elevators, and endless stairwells while the floors are slick with blood and crawling with mutated creatures. Leon fires through the chaos with torn tactical gear, Jill fights through smoke and infection with fierce precision, Claire stands amid fallen abominations and shattered medical lights, and Pyramid Head drags a massive blade through sparks, gore, and steel. The setting should feel suffocating, industrial, and nightmarish, with siren-red lighting, rusted pipes, dripping shadows, and oppressive psychological horror. Violent, cinematic, disturbing, and unforgettable.
A 21:9 ultra-wide fantasy magic-war scene showing adult Harry Potter, adult Hermione Granger, Gandalf, and Doctor Strange standing together in the middle of a catastrophic arcane battlefield beneath a storm-torn sky. A vast ancient city of towers, bridges, and floating libraries collapses as giant magical beasts and dark armored sorcerers tear through the streets. Harry casts amid shattered stone and bloodied robes, Hermione fights fiercely with glowing runes and burning debris around her, Gandalf holds the line with staff and sword against monstrous cavalry, and Doctor Strange bends fractured reality above broken magic circles. A 21:9 ultra-wide post-apocalyptic machine war scene featuring RoboCop, Terminator, Judge Dredd, and Mad Max battling through a collapsing industrial wasteland full of burning refineries, exploding vehicles, and dead raiders. RoboCop advances with damaged armor and blazing muzzle flash, Terminator marches through explosions with exposed endoskeleton and brutal precision, Judge Dredd fires from behind shattered barricades, and Mad Max barrels through the carnage in a ramshackle interceptor surrounded by spikes, wreckage, and smoke. A 21:9 ultra-wide cosmic crossover battle scene showing Superman, Optimus Prime, Godzilla, and Iron Man fighting together at the center of a destroyed megacity as an alien invasion tears open the sky. Skyscrapers collapse, space portals burn above the clouds, and giant biomechanical warships descend through smoke while the streets below drown in debris, crushed tanks, and blood-streaked ruins. Superman dives through flaming wreckage with bruised face and torn cape, Optimus Prime crushes alien walkers in a storm of sparks and metal shards, Godzilla releases atomic fury into swarming kaiju and titanic drones, and Iron Man fires through the chaos amid burning towers and shattered highways.
